title: Token to Goal: 3 by 3 Grid Puzzle
description: A flat 3 by 3 board of tiles seen from above at an angle. A red sphere token starts on the bottom-left square; a raised gold disc marks the goal on the top-right square. Up, Down, Left and Right buttons move the token one square. Hint shows an orange arrow from the token toward a square one step closer to the goal. Readouts show moves made and steps left to the goal.

game.objective: Move the token from the bottom-left square to the gold goal square on the top-right.
game.hint: Each move changes one row or one column. The shortest route is the rows plus the columns between you and the goal: 4 moves from the start.

assumptions: This is a simple made-up puzzle, not a model of anything real.
The token moves only up, down, left or right, never diagonally, so 'steps to goal' counts the up/down steps plus the left/right steps (taxicab distance).
The token starts on the bottom-left square and the goal is the top-right square, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.
Once the token reaches the goal, the game is won and the move buttons stop working until you press Reset.
Up means away from the starting camera view (toward the goal row); the hint prefers a Right move while one helps, otherwise Up.
